name: Test Coverage Threshold
description: Source Code must meet differentiated line, branch and critical-path coverage thresholds before Verification passes.

conditions.statement: Line coverage >= the threshold declared by the active governance tier.

requiredEvidence.title: Test Result — Line Coverage
requiredEvidence.description: Line coverage >= the threshold declared by the active governance tier.

exceptionRules.exceptionStatement: Legacy code under active remediation may be granted a temporary lower threshold, time-boxed and tracked as an Obligation.
exceptionRules.duration: Time-boxed per the linked remediation Obligation's own completion criteria
exceptionRules.exceptionScope: The specific legacy module(s) under remediation only
exceptionRules.reviewRequirements: Tracked via a linked Obligation; reviewed at each remediation milestone.

conditions.statement: Branch coverage >= the threshold declared by the active governance tier.

requiredEvidence.title: Test Result — Branch Coverage
requiredEvidence.description: Branch coverage >= the threshold declared by the active governance tier.

conditions.statement: Modules tagged critical-path (authentication, payment, data-integrity) meet a threshold at least 15 points higher than the general threshold.

requiredEvidence.title: Test Result — Line Coverage
requiredEvidence.description: Modules tagged critical-path (authentication, payment, data-integrity) meet a threshold at least 15 points higher than the general threshold.

conditions.statement: No source file is excluded from coverage measurement without a documented, Authority-approved justification.

requiredEvidence.title: Coverage Exclusion Record
requiredEvidence.description: No source file is excluded from coverage measurement without a documented, Authority-approved justification.
